description: This Dart file defines the 'OceanTheme' class which provides a customized ThemeData for a Flutter application, including various theme configurations for UI components such as AppBar, Card, InputDecoration, Buttons, Chips, Divider, SnackBar, NavigationBar, BottomAppBar, and FloatingActionButton. It focuses on a specific color scheme and style consistent with an 'Ocean Professional' theme.

classes.name: OceanTheme
classes.description: A class providing a static method to generate ThemeData following the Ocean Professional style.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: A static getter that returns a ThemeData object configured with the Ocean Professional color scheme and styling.
